subject: Staff-managed office and service pages for APD
text:
Hello APD team,

I saw your May newsletter announcing the move to Woodcliff Drive in Fairport.

I'm Ramish, founder of Nexora. We've built a website CMS for staff to draft, preview and publish branded information pages. A focused evaluation could use three sample office, service and news pages with one editor before agreeing a wider scope.

The proposed attachment is a 90-second narrated and captioned introduction to Nexora's wider membership platform. A website-editor walkthrough would focus on public content.

Would a 15-minute look at managing office and service updates be useful?

Best,
Ramish Qureshi
Founder, Nexora
ramishqureshi99@gmail.com
